covers: Wall Street close and after-hours trade on Wednesday 11 November 2026, and South Africa overnight to 06:15 SAST Thursday 12 November
headline: Breaking: Nvidia falls 8-9% after hours on a WSJ report that its board may remove CEO Jensen Huang; Nasdaq futures lower after the index closed 1.6% higher
summary: The JSE All Share closed Wednesday at 113,449.53 (-1.1%) and the Top 40 at 105,558.44 (-1.1%), and the rand was at R16.60/$ early on Thursday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11-12 Nov 2026). On Wall Street the S&P 500 closed 1.3% higher at 7,619.38 and the Nasdaq 1.6% higher at 25,466.19 on an AI-share rally, but Nvidia then fell 8-9% after hours on headlines that its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang, pulling Nasdaq-100 futures lower (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; WSJ via CNBC, MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov). Gold closed below $4,000 at $3,984.20 and Brent at $91.73 as bets on bigger Fed rate hikes lifted the dollar, so a weaker tech open and a strong dollar are the main risks for the JSE and the rand today (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; Investing.com headlines, 12 Nov).

items.title: Nvidia drops 8-9% after hours on report its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia closed Wednesday's regular session at $173.73, up 2.9% (LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 23:00 SAST). After the close, CNBC said the Wall Street Journal reported Nvidia is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and MarketWatch and Moneyweb headlines put the after-hours fall at 8% to 9%; a further headline says the board is meeting to decide his future. We could not open the articles, so we give no detail on the board's reasons, any company statement or a successor, and the after-hours price is not a closing price. This follows earlier headlines this week about an affair and calls for his resignation. Nvidia results are still due on 17 November.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 23:00 SAST; CNBC (citing WSJ), MarketWatch and Moneyweb headlines, 12 Nov 2026 02:21-03:18 SAST

items.title: Nasdaq-100 futures slide as the Nvidia sell-off resumes
items.summary: A CNBC live-updates headline at 05:13 SAST says Nasdaq-100 futures were sliding, dragged lower by Nvidia. We could not open the page for futures levels. This reverses part of Wednesday's 1.6% Nasdaq gain, so the US open at 16:30 SAST is the key test.

items.title: S&P 500 up 1.3%, Nasdaq up 1.6% at Wednesday's close
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,619.38 (+1.3% from 7,520.93) and the Nasdaq Composite at 25,466.19 (+1.6% from 25,065.88), slightly off their intraday highs; a MarketWatch headline says the Dow gained 250 points. Micron closed at $811.30 (+11.9%) and CoreWeave at $60.77 (+24.7%), which CNBC calls its best day since April 2025 after a strong third-quarter report.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 close; MarketWatch and CNBC headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield ends at about 5.00%
items.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.998% on 11 Nov, up from 4.859% a week earlier. A MarketWatch headline notes lower oil prices are no longer bringing down bond yields; we could not open the article.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; MarketWatch headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: CFTC investigating Kalshi over event contracts
items.summary: A CNBC headline says the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is investigating whether prediction-market operator Kalshi improperly self-certified event contracts. We could not open the article for details.

items.title: JSE closed 1.1% lower on Wednesday; Woolworths down 8.5%
items.summary: The All Share closed at 113,449.53 and the Top 40 at 105,558.44, both 1.1% lower. Woolworths ended at R37.78 (-8.5%); a Moneyweb headline links the fall to the collapse of David Jones in Australia, even though Woolworths sold that business in 2023. We could not open the article. Woolworths is not on our coverage list.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; Moneyweb headline, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Ramokgopa to publish a case for new nuclear reactors
items.summary: A Moneyweb headline says Electricity Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa will publish a science-based case for new nuclear reactors. We could not open the article for timing or cost estimates.

items.title: Rand R16.60/$, R18.39/€, R22.00/£ as the dollar strengthens
items.summary: The rand was at R16.60/$, R18.39/€ and R22.00/£ early on 12 Nov, against R16.48/$ a week ago. An Investing.com headline says the dollar extended its surge to a more than 19-month high on raised Fed rate-hike expectations; we could not open the article for index levels.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026; Investing.com headline, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Gold closes below $4,000 at $3,984.20; platinum $1,535.60
items.summary: Gold closed at $3,984.20 on 11 Nov, down from $4,074.90 a week earlier, and platinum at $1,535.60. Investing.com headlines say gold fell for a second session and is holding below $4,000 as inflation fears fuel bets on bigger Fed hikes. We could not open the articles.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; Investing.com headlines, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Brent $91.73; oil falls further on peace-talk hopes; copper $13,774/t
items.summary: Brent closed at $91.73 on 11 Nov (-0.8% from $92.47) and copper at about $13,774 a tonne. An Investing.com headline at 03:54 SAST says oil dropped more than $1 on hopes for Iran and Ukraine peace talks; separately a Daily Maverick headline says Saudi Arabia reported debris from intercepted missiles falling in the Mecca region. We could not open the articles for current prices.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026; Investing.com and Daily Maverick headlines, 12 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia: CEO report hits the shares after hours
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $173.73 (+2.9%) on 11 Nov before falling 8-9% after hours on the report that the board may oust Jensen Huang (headlines, see Breaking). Our BUY rating and fair value of $262.56 are unchanged (LRC Watchlist); a leadership change is a governance risk we will assess once the facts are confirmed, but news reports do not change the rating. Results are due 17 November.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 23:00 SAST; CNBC/MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist

items.title: Meta: head of infrastructure to leave
items.summary: A CNBC headline says Meta's head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by a former AWS cloud executive; we could not open the article for names. Meta closed at $628.77 (-2.0%) on 11 Nov. Our SELL rating and fair value of $677.14 are unchanged (LRC Watchlist).
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 23:00 SAST; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD closes 7.3% higher
items.summary: AMD closed at $552.90 (+7.3%) on 11 Nov in the AI-chip rally, further above our fair value of $402.73; our SELL rating is unchanged (LRC Watchlist).
